meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: A person raises a payment change and then approves it themselves. Asked with no rule against it, and with a four-eyes rule (the approver must be someone other than the requester)
results.expected_in_words: With no rule the request is approved by its own requester and runs; with the four-eyes rule the self-approval is refused

results.title: After a request is approved, the requester edits the amount before it runs. Asked when the approval is tied only to the request number, and when it is tied to a fingerprint of the exact content that was approved
results.expected_in_words: The edited request runs under the old approval when only the number is checked; with a fingerprint, the edit voids the approval

results.title: An approver is shown 20 requests at once and approves them all with one click; one of the 20 is far over the normal limit. Asked when batch approval has no limit, and when high-risk requests are excluded from batches
results.expected_in_words: With no limit the oversized request goes through in the batch; when high-risk items must be approved one by one, it is held back

results.title: A request is approved on Monday and the system runs it on Thursday. Asked with no expiry on approvals, and with approvals that lapse after 24 hours
results.expected_in_words: With no expiry the three-day-old approval still runs; with a 24-hour lapse it is refused and must be asked again

results.title: The only approver for a queue of pending requests leaves the company. Asked when the queue stays with the leaver, and when pending requests move to the approver's manager on departure
results.expected_in_words: The requests wait for a person who no longer exists; with reassignment, a current approver can act on them

results.title: Two approvers are asked about the same request: one approves and one denies. Asked when any one approval is enough, and when a single denial wins
results.expected_in_words: With 'any one approval' the request runs even though a second approver said no; with deny-wins it does not

results.title: Two people each approve the other's requests, and nobody else ever looks at either request
results.expected_in_words: Every rule above is satisfied (different people, exact content, in time) and both requests run; the lab cannot see the arrangement. This is a limit, not a control
